manual_steps: Continue autonomously; no owner testing/input, client, installation, owner configuration/world/process changes or production adoption.
Initial dispatch failed before admission, then a stale snapshot blocked validation. Both designated r1 cost directories remain unused; use them once with this revision's fresh evidence logs.

R3 validation stopped at an obsolete preparation-test expectation before compilation or native preparation. R4 corrects only that test and uses new r4 logs; both designated native directories are still unused.

R4 became stale solely because an untracked Python test bytecode file changed. Preserve it and all owner state; use -B for every Python check to prevent cache writes. Freshness checks remain unchanged and mandatory.
R5 passed preparation checks but compilation stopped on a missing readiness diagnostic supplier. R6 adds that argument only; no native target has been prepared or run.

R6 compiled but passed only 19/20 JVM checks. R7 rejects recorder re-arming after finish and reserves the strict initial-placement terrain check for setup, retaining natural-rest and phase-boundary probes after landings. Both native targets remain unused.
Author execution is prohibited: new source/tests remain uncompiled/unrun. Authorized lead must compile/test first and stop on failure before native runs.

Measure single-cabin headless server-tick envelopes only, not Sable-only CPU, TPS or capacity. No performance threshold, M1 acceptance or M2-M6 advancement. Keep baseline burial and intermittent hull-state findings unresolved.
